February 9, 1971
2014-12-14T00:00:00+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/february-9-1971-55341

·         Indian radio reports people torching few shops and houses after staging demonstration against the blasting of an Indian aircraft hijacked from Lahore. 16-hour curfew enforced in Ahmedabad.

·         Professor Muzaffar Ahmed, chief of East Pakistan National Awami Party, and its General Secetary Syed Altaf Hussain in a newspaper statement urge the president to call for immediate National Assembly session. A vested and extreme communal force is trying to create tension over the aircraft hijack incident to delay the National Assembly session and transfer of power to the representatives of people.
